NEBIUS_API_KEY.description: Optional. Your own Nebius API key. With it, a check uses the live model, and together with CONTREE_PROJECT_ID it runs in Contree sandboxes. This project does not ship or share a key. The value is not stored in the repository.

CONTREE_PROJECT_ID.description: Optional. Your own Contree project ID. With NEBIUS_API_KEY, checks run in Contree sandboxes instead of bubblewrap. Not stored in the repository.

TAVILY_API_KEY.description: Your own Tavily API key. The setup lookup needs it. This project does not ship or share a key. Tavily keys are free. Without a key the lookup is skipped and the check continues. The value is not stored in the repository.
